units.source_text: 此后半年期间，我所苦恼的，毋宁说是另一件事。

en.t: During the half year after that, what tormented me was, rather, something else.

units.source_text: 每到月底，柏木总要向我摧债，还要加上利息，还要责骂几句脏话。

en.t: At the end of every month, Kashiwagi would demand repayment from me, add interest on top of it, and curse me with a few filthy words.
I no longer had any intention of paying the money back.

units.source_text: 为了不与柏木照面，旷课就好了。

en.t: To avoid meeting Kashiwagi face to face, all I had to do was skip class.
